title: Final Answer (a)
description: Essential Criteria - The student must correctly derive and present the final answer for part (a) as S Omega A.

title: Final Answer (b)
description: Essential Criteria - The student must correctly derive and present the final answer for part (b) as Omega A.

title: Final Answer (c)
description: Essential Criteria - The student must correctly explain the conclusion for part (c) as S' <= S.

title: Key Reasoning (a)
description: Important Criteria - The student should demonstrate understanding of how the effective area and solid angle relate to the energy entering the telescope.

title: Key Reasoning (b)
description: Important Criteria - The student should show the relationship between the image area and the solid angle subtended by the lens.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria - The student must avoid errors in calculating the solid angle or the area of the lens.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria - The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria - The student could discuss limiting cases or assumptions made in the derivation.
